title: Unity Theatre

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Embark on a theatrical adventure with Unity Theatre’s Summer Drama Camp, an electrifying experience for kids entering Grades 2-12! Delve into the world of live theatre, where creativity knows no bounds, and the magic of performance comes to life. Our outstanding team of seasoned teaching artists and performers will guide your child through a transformative journey, igniting creativity, exploring imaginations, and unveiling the secrets of crafting captivating characters. Scholarships Available: Unlock opportunities for your child with FULL and PARTIAL SCHOLARSHIPS, ensuring that every aspiring artist can join the theatrical excitement! Scroll further down this page to access the Scholarship
